items.difficulty_reason: Extension lemma (statement 2644-2666, proof 2668-2698): the one-step coskeleton extension - the new term is a representable functor of compatible families, the structure maps are transplanted from the coskeleton-existence lemma, and the adjunction bijection is constructed in both directions; the only unverified step is the mutual-inverse check, recorded in the notes. H2: adjunction bookkeeping over established limit descriptions.
